name: quicknote
title: Quick Note
description: Quickly append notes to a daily Markdown file locally or over SSH.
author: owenps

commands.name: quicknote
commands.title: Quick Note
commands.description: Append a note to today's daily Markdown file locally or over SSH.

preferences.name: fileMode
preferences.title: File Mode
preferences.description: Use a new file each day or one fixed file.

preferences.name: staticFilename
preferences.title: Static Filename
preferences.description: Used in Static mode, e.g. inbox.md

preferences.name: localFolder
preferences.title: Local Notes Folder
preferences.description: Used when Storage is Local, e.g. ~/Notes

preferences.name: remoteShell
preferences.title: Remote Shell
preferences.description: Choose the shell used by the SSH host.

preferences.name: sshTarget
preferences.title: SSH Target
preferences.description: Used when Storage is SSH, e.g. user@host or an SSH config alias

preferences.name: remoteFolder
preferences.title: Remote Notes Folder
preferences.description: Used when Storage is SSH; path on the remote host
